history.summary: Freehold 1,227 sqft 3BR in East Coast (D15) at $1,548 PSF — ~6% below the $1,642 URA median — with TEL access at Marine Terrace. Freehold tenure, sub-median entry and a deep D15 buyer pool are genuine positives, but the eye-catching 9.17% appreciation rests on just 17 txns and the development is a small 1992-vintage block.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold, $1,548 PSF below the $1,642 median, in deep-pool East Coast with TE27 Marine Terrace (~950m) — a solid value-and-location combination. The 9.17% headline CAGR is over only 17 txns so I discount it heavily, but even at a conservative D15 freehold growth rate the entry value and TEL catalyst justify a Buy. Small/older development is the main caveat.
red_flags: 9.17% rate from only 17 txns — treat as indicative, not reliable
catalysts: Sub-median PSF entry in deep-pool D15
